cash_movement_valid.name: cash_movement_valid
cash_movement_valid.value: "cash_movements"."kind" IN ('payment','deposit','withdrawal') AND "cash_movements"."method" IN ('cash','transfer','qr','card') AND "cash_movements"."amount_cents" > 0 AND ("cash_movements"."kind" = 'payment') = ("cash_movements"."order_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("cash_movements"."kind" = 'payment' OR "cash_movements"."method" = 'cash') AND ("cash_movements"."tendered_cents" IS NULL OR ("cash_movements"."method" = 'cash' AND "cash_movements"."tendered_cents" >= "cash_movements"."amount_cents")) AND ("cash_movements"."voided_at" IS NULL) = ("cash_movements"."void_reason" IS NULL)

cash_session_valid.name: cash_session_valid
cash_session_valid.value: "cash_sessions"."opening_cents" >= 0 AND ("cash_sessions"."closed_at" IS NULL) = ("cash_sessions"."declared_cents" IS NULL) AND ("cash_sessions"."closed_at" IS NULL) = ("cash_sessions"."expected_cents" IS NULL) AND ("cash_sessions"."closed_at" IS NULL) = ("cash_sessions"."close_request_key" IS NULL) AND ("cash_sessions"."declared_cents" IS NULL OR "cash_sessions"."declared_cents" >= 0)

inventory_item_valid.name: inventory_item_valid
inventory_item_valid.value: "inventory_items"."kind" IN ('ingredient','finished') AND "inventory_items"."unit" IN ('g','ml','unit') AND "inventory_items"."minimum" >= 0 AND ("inventory_items"."unit_cost" IS NULL OR "inventory_items"."unit_cost" >= 0)
